metaDescription: Flomaton, Escambia County sits near the historic Jay Field Norphlet gas trend. Get a clear cash offer on your south Alabama mineral interest.
heroLead: Flomaton sits right on the Alabama-Florida line in Escambia County, close to the edge of the Jay Field trend, one of the largest Norphlet gas and Smackover oil discoveries ever made along the Gulf Coast.
intro: Jay Field, discovered in 1970 just across the state line in Florida, extends into a portion of Escambia County, Alabama, and the leasing and production activity it triggered reshaped mineral ownership across this whole corner of the state. If your family holds a Flomaton-area interest, there is a real chance it connects to this history in some way.

sections.heading: What Jay Field means for a Flomaton interest
paragraphs: The Jay Field trend produces from the Norphlet sandstone, a gas-condensate reservoir sitting above the deeper Smackover carbonate, both trapped in a large, well-defined structure that made this discovery so significant when it was made. Wells on the Alabama side of the trend, including acreage near Flomaton, have produced for decades, though like any large mature field, output has declined substantially from its early peak.

We check whether your specific tract sits within the historical field boundary or its extension area, since that materially affects both the likelihood of current production and the strength of any offer we can make.

sections.heading: Escambia County Probate records and older leases
paragraphs: Because Jay Field triggered heavy leasing activity in this area starting in the early 1970s, a lot of Flomaton-area deeds and lease documents from that period are on file with the Escambia County Probate Office in Brewton. If your family signed a lease around that time and has not revisited it since, that office is often where we start confirming its current status.
Some of these decades-old leases are still held by production today, meaning they remain active and continue generating royalties, while others have lapsed.

faqs.question: Is my Flomaton property actually inside the Jay Field boundary?
faqs.answer: Some Flomaton-area tracts are within or near the field's Alabama extension; we check your specific legal description against historical unit maps to confirm.

faqs.question: How deep does Jay Field production come from?
faqs.answer: The Norphlet sandstone and the deeper Smackover formation, both several thousand feet down, are the productive intervals in this trend.

faqs.question: My family's lease dates back to the early 1970s. Is it still active?
faqs.answer: It depends on whether production has continued to hold it; we research current well status tied to your specific lease before answering definitively.

faqs.question: Where are older Flomaton-area lease documents typically filed?
faqs.answer: With the Escambia County Probate Office in Brewton, which holds deed and lease records for the whole county.
